Functional Checks
Interactive Procedural Trainers — practice anytime, not scored
Fuel System Functional Check
Step 1 of 2 — press the correct switch on the synoptic
How This Check Works
  • Press the switch or valve on the synoptic for the current step. If it's correct, it moves and the check advances.
  • A wrong press does nothing at first — after 3 wrong tries, the correct control lights up for you.
  • Valves take a couple seconds to move; pump switches react instantly.
  • This is a practice trainer — nothing here is scored.
Buttons
  • Undo Last Step — backs up one step so you can redo it, without resetting the whole check.
  • Reset Check — starts the entire check over from Step 1.
  • ← Home (top left) — leaves this check and returns to the main menu. Your progress here isn't saved.
Baseline: APU running on Left Main pump. Begin the check.
Standby Rudder Functional Check
Press the STBY RUD switch to see its effect on the hydraulic system
How This Check Works
  • This synoptic shows a dual hydraulic system failure in flight — both EDPs are down.
  • Press the STBY RUD switch on the synoptic to turn it ON. The AUX pump starts, the directional valve rotates, and pressure is routed to YD1 and the rudder.
  • Press it again to turn it back OFF — the AUX pump returns to standby and the YD1 feed is removed.
  • This is a practice trainer — nothing here is scored.
Buttons
  • ← Home (top left) — leaves this check and returns to the main menu.
